notes: v1.5.0 is the content-depth release: runbook library (every alarm carries a 3-5 step runbook with expected outcomes, cross-linked from the NOC detail panel, palette search and the 3D rogue inspector), per-signal why-this-matters lines in the SOC signal basis, three guidance learning tracks (executive demo / operator drill / accessibility walkthrough), a 22-term LTE glossary, synthetic UE personas in the subscriber drawer, and a how-to-read-this narrative with per-assumption hints in the business case.
